title.narrative: Establishment of the Women and Development Agency

description.narrative: Provide financial, technical and administrative support in the establishment of the Women and Development Agency (WDA) as a designated, imbedded body within the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), to address the need to accelerate women’s economic participation, end violence against women and prevent violent extremism and effectively apply the principle of ‘Leaving no one Behind’.

The grant aims to provide financial, technical and administrative support in the establishment of the Women and Development Agency as a designated, imbedded body within the Organization for Islamic Cooperation (OIC), to address the need to accelerate women’s economic participation, end violence against women and prevent violent extremism and effectively apply the principle of ‘Leaving no one Behind’.
